name: style-air
title: Air
description: The default cool blue Neumorphism UI style with balanced depth and soft controls.

light.neu-shadow-inset: inset 2px 2px 6px rgb(30 48 72 / 0.14), inset -2px -2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.88) 97%, transparent)
light.neu-shadow-primary: 2px 3px 7px rgb(30 48 72 / 0.14), -2px -2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.88) 94%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #1267f4 72%, white)
light.neu-shadow-primary-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #1267f4 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #1267f4 78%, white)
light.neu-shadow-destructive-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #b92e43 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #b92e43 78%, white)

dark.neu-shadow-inset: inset 2px 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.34), inset -2px -2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.065) 97%, transparent)
dark.neu-shadow-primary: 2px 3px 7px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.34), -2px -2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.065) 94%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #5aa2ff 72%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-primary-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #5aa2ff 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #5aa2ff 78%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-destructive-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #ff7685 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, #ff7685 78%, white)
